Weekday Night
Dec 2024 • Friends
I was here with my friends this night and it was the first time I've ever been to this kind of place. It was not too crowded - which was very pleasant because I don't like getting stuck with noisy people (perhaps I visited on weekdays). I ordered 2 cocktails with some fries and steak, they were all tasty. Tan and Nguyet were very helpful helping me choose the right dishes and they did it perfectly.
I'll be happy to come back here many times more :)

Great views, disappointing service
Dec 2023 • Friends
Visited 30th Dec in a large group of 16. Loved the atmosphere when we arrived, good music selection and fab views of the city. There was a large selection of cocktails; prices were on the high side for HMC, especially for beer. It was service that let things down. I suspect they are not used to dealing with large groups. Drinks took a long time to come. Paying for our drinks brought new challenges! My husband was asked for his room number to charge his drink but we were not staying st the hotel, which seemed to confuse the staff no end. Overall a bit disappointing.
